baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated root in al-nashirati nashran joins a feminine plural active participle to its cognate verbal noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The participle identifies plural agents by an ongoing act, while the cognate noun intensifies that act. The root image makes the act an opening of something compact into an extended, branching field.

activation_trace.role: Opening, spreading, and branching are the literal image and supply the mechanism's compact-to-expanded transition.

changed_reading.after: Plural agents are defined by fully opening a compact thing into an extended and branching field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both words in the focus phrase carry the root ن ش ر, whose B002 branch directly names revival after death.
baseline_models.mechanism: The intensified spreading can be a transition from inert closure to renewed life, so expansion is temporal and vital rather than merely spatial.

activation_trace.role: Reviving the dead is the literal branch image and turns spreading into reanimation after cessation.

changed_reading.after: The act can be renewed animation: what had ceased is made to rise into life again.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root's B004 branch depicts dry pasture greening when rain reaches it.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dormant surface receives water and opens into distributed growth; spreading therefore joins moisture, revival, and visible vegetative expansion.

activation_trace.role: Rain-revived dry pasture literally supplies an ecological dormant-to-green expansion.

changed_reading.before: The spreading has no specified material result.
changed_reading.after: The spreading can be life-bearing expansion, like dry ground opening into green growth under rain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root's B009 branch names writing, an unsealed document, and opened pages.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agents may unroll or publish what had been closed, converting a bounded inscription into exposed and transmissible content.

activation_trace.role: The open written document is the literal image and grounds publication as exposure and circulation.

changed_reading.before: The agents spread an unspecified object.
changed_reading.after: The agents unseal and publish written content, laying it open for reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The open-document branch of ن ش ر becomes one operation in a communicative sequence: dispatch initiates movement, publication exposes and distributes content, distinction makes its divisions effective, and casting places the reminder before recipients.

activation_trace.role: An open written document literally supplies the content-bearing form that is exposed and circulated.
Messenger and message literally supply a commissioned communicative source for the unfolding.
Distinguishing two things supplies the differentiating effect of content once it is laid open.
Casting a thing until it is placed supplies the delivery step that externalizes the published content.
A reminder that causes recollection identifies the delivered content's mnemonic function.

structural_cues: 77:1-5 is a linked run of feminine plural active participles.
77:1-4 reinforce each participle with an accusative cognate noun before 77:5 names the delivered reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, open writing, distinction, casting, and reminder images; I infer successive functions in one communicative operation. A live alternative is that these are coordinated but distinct oath subjects rather than stages of one process.

changed_reading.before: The agents simply unroll an open document.
changed_reading.after: Commissioned agents publish a reminder into circulation so its distinctions are exposed and its content is delivered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The neutral opening of ن ش ر is pressurized by violent wind and airborne debris. Spreading becomes the middle operation by which force loosens a mass, expands its particles, and makes separation or sorting possible.

activation_trace.role: Opening and branching supply the expanded state produced between force and separation.
A severe wind that lifts and scatters things supplies the driving force behind expansion.
Scattering into parts supplies the downstream result of force-driven spreading.
Flying or elevated debris gives the dispersed state a concrete material form.

structural_cues: 77:2, 77:3, and 77:4 place force, spreading, and separation in immediate sequence.
The later erasure, opening, and removal of stars, sky, and mountains in 77:8-10 repeat mass-to-dispersal transformations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies violent wind, opening, scattering, and airborne matter; I infer a causal arrow from force through expansion to separated particles. The alternative is three independent actions with no shared material substrate.

changed_reading.after: Spreading is force-driven decompression that converts a compact mass into dispersed and distinguishable parts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Against a timed sequence in which marks are erased, the sky is opened, mountains are removed, all are gathered, and judgment separates, ن ش ר reads as preparatory unsealing: the ordered world or its record is laid open so hidden distinctions can become adjudicable.

activation_trace.role: Opening and spreading supply the unsealed state in which formerly bounded contents become exposed.
Erasing a trace supplies the undoing of one established sign-system before disclosure.
Opening a gap between two things supplies the rupture through which enclosure is undone.
Uprooting and removing from place supplies the dismantling of fixed boundaries.
Fixing an act to a time or limit makes the unsealing an appointed operation rather than random diffusion.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the adjudicative end of exposure.
Gathering scattered elements into one whole supplies the assembly whose contents are then distinguished.

structural_cues: 77:8-13 is a chained when-then sequence culminating in the Day of Separation.
77:38 explicitly combines the Day of Separation with gathering the present audience and the earlier ones.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies erasure, rupture, removal, appointment, gathering, and adjudicative separation; I infer that the focus opening prepares visibility for judgment. A live alternative is physical cosmic dispersal without any documentary or revelatory layer.

changed_reading.before: The spreaders expand matter in space.
changed_reading.after: The spreaders perform an appointed unsealing that lays an ordered whole open for gathering, exposure, and decisive separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The revival branches of ن ش ר are embedded in a containment-and-release cycle: generative water is lodged securely for a measured term, earth gathers living and dead, and supplied water turns dormant ground toward life. Spreading is the emergence phase in which latent life becomes distributed and visible.

activation_trace.role: Revival after death literally supplies the transition from cessation to renewed life.
Dry pasture greening under rain supplies the ecological form of released life.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the generative transition that spreading makes manifest.
Male generative fluid in the womb supplies life held in a latent material state.
Fixity and settlement supply the stable enclosure preceding emergence.
Gathering and holding in a container supplies the earth's enfolding phase.
Earth living through rain and plants supplies the visible outcome of ecological revival.
Dead land or matter without spirit supplies the dormant state from which revival proceeds.
Providing irrigation supplies the water-bearing cause of the green expansion.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 moves from weak water through secure lodging and measured duration to creative power.
77:25-27 presents earth as a container of living and dead, then adds fixed mountains and supplied fresh water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generative fluid, secure containment, living and dead earth, irrigation, and rain-revived pasture; I infer a recurring containment-to-release arrow. The live alternative is that resurrection, embryology, and vegetation remain separate analogies rather than one cycle.

changed_reading.before: Revival is only a direct return of the dead.
changed_reading.after: The spreaders enact emergence from containment, distributing latent life as embryonic creation, green growth, and possible resurrection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Spreading is constrained by its opposites and outcomes: a gathered whole can be unfolded into branches whose internal differences become visible. This makes ن ش ר articulated expansion rather than indefinite diffusion.

activation_trace.role: Branching from an opened whole supplies the central articulated-expansion geometry.
Making a distinction until a boundary appears supplies the legibility of the unfolded parts.
Branching and divergence give the spread field an explicitly ramified shape.
Joining scattered elements into one whole supplies the inverse movement against which unfolding is defined.

structural_cues: The focus spreading is immediately followed by separating in 77:4.
The three-branched form in 77:30 and the gathering for separation in 77:38 repeat branch-whole relations at distant points in the surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spreading, boundary-making, branching, and gathering; I infer a reversible whole-to-parts operation in which gathering permits ordered articulation. The alternative is that gathering merely opposes dispersal and does not explain the focus action.

changed_reading.before: Spreading means motion away from a center.
changed_reading.after: Spreading articulates a gathered whole into branches and bounded parts that can be distinguished.

context_deltas.mechanism: The publication branch of ن ش ر sits inside a whole-surah speech arc: a reminder is cast, later speech and permission are withheld, a spoken command is refused, and the final question denies any later discourse as a ground for belief. Publication thus reaches an evidentiary endpoint rather than merely increasing range.

activation_trace.role: The unsealed written document supplies publication as the opening act of the speech arc.
Mention running on the tongue supplies the reminder's audible circulation.
Literal speech supplies the capacity that is later blocked.
Permission to act supplies the authorization withheld from a counter-response.
Uttered speech supplies the explicit command that tests reception of the circulated message.
Speech continually renewed as report supplies the possible later discourse that the closing question excludes.
Heart-settling assent supplies the reception that no subsequent discourse is expected to produce.

structural_cues: The opening chain ends with casting a reminder in 77:5.
77:35-36 closes speech and permission, 77:48 stages a refused spoken command, and 77:50 asks what later discourse could produce belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circulated reminder, blocked speech, withheld permission, uttered command, renewed report, and assent; I infer that focus publication exhausts the discourse horizon. The alternative is a rhetorical frame whose later speech scenes do not feed back into the lexical force of ن ش ر.

changed_reading.before: Publication exposes content to an audience.
changed_reading.after: Publication circulates the decisive reminder so fully that later counter-speech and any substitute discourse lose standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The branching image of ن ش ر is realized as two opposed distributions: one branch-shaped field fails to shelter and ejects flying sparks, while another field provides real shade, flowing springs, and fruit. Spreading becomes allocation into materially different outcome-zones.

activation_trace.role: Opening into branches supplies the geometry by which one field can distribute opposed outcomes.
Shade as cover supplies the protective function invoked but denied in the punitive branch.
Diverging branches give the punitive field the same ramified geometry as focus spreading.
Sending or throwing supplies the outward propulsion within the destructive distribution.
Flying sparks supply the harmful particles spread through that field.
A flowing water source supplies the life-bearing distribution in the protective field.
Pleasant fruit supplies the consumable yield of the beneficial distribution.

structural_cues: 77:30-33 builds a branching pseudo-shade that does not protect and instead emits sparks.
77:41-42 answers it with actual shades, springs, and desired fruit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branching, failed cover, propelled sparks, real shade, water sources, and fruit; I infer two outcome-zones generated by distribution. The alternative is simply a contrast of punishments and rewards with no feedback into the focus verb.

changed_reading.after: Spreading can ramify into opposed material fields, distributing destructive particles on one side and sheltering abundance on the other.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because scent is remote from the dominant spatial and communicative readings, but both cited branches literally name fragrance and the focus remains anchored in ن ش ר. Render only as a possible sensory image of diffusion, not as an identification of the oath agents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B003 branch is fragrant scent spreading through space.

activation_trace.role: Diffused pleasant scent literally supplies the focus image of an expanding fragrant trace.
Scent and perfuming literally supply a nearby sensory cue that makes fragrance a coherent mode of spreading.

changed_reading.before: The spreaders leave an unspecified expanding effect.
changed_reading.after: The parallel agents may be sensed as carrying a recognizable fragrant wake that diffuses as they pass.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material reading is surprising because sawing is a specialized root branch and the context never names wood. It remains anchored by ن ش ر B005 and is reinforced by husk, separated parts, airborne residue, and cutting; render it as an analogy for disaggregation into fallout, never as a literal claim about the agents' object.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B005 branch names sawing wood and the cuttings that fall from it.

activation_trace.role: Sawing and its fallen cuttings literally supply a solid-to-particle disaggregation image.
Crumbled husk and crop leaves supply a second image of a solid reduced to light fragments.
Scattering into parts supplies the separation produced by cutting.
Flying residue supplies the airborne field formed from the separated particles.
Cutting and shaking literally reinforce the mechanical breakup analogy.

changed_reading.before: Spreading moves already separate things outward.
changed_reading.after: Spreading may include the prior act of cutting a coherent body into light residue and then distributing that residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because generosity is a socially distant ن ش ر branch, but B010 directly anchors it and the later context supplies good condition, drink, pleasant fruit, and sufficient gift. Render as a lexical resonance of bounty being opened and distributed, not as a settled referent for the opening oath.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B010 branch names open generosity and nobility.

activation_trace.role: Open generosity literally supplies a social-distributive sense of spreading bounty.
Good condition and favor supply the beneficial state produced by bounty.
Giving drink literally supplies one distributed gift.
Pleasant well-being and delight supply the experiential yield of generosity.
A sufficient gift literally supplies the provision opened to its recipients.

changed_reading.before: The spreaders distribute matter or information.
changed_reading.after: The spreaders may also resonate as open-handed distributors whose expansion takes the form of provision and ease.

strongest_changes: The opening sequence revises document-unfolding into dispatched publication of a differentiating reminder.
Violent wind, separation, and airborne residue turn neutral expansion into force-driven disaggregation.
Creation, containment, living-and-dead earth, and irrigation strengthen spreading as release of latent life.
The whole-surah speech arc makes publication exhaustive: later speech is blocked and no substitute discourse remains.
summary.what_was_special: The same compact focus phrase remained live across spatial, communicative, vital, material, and distributive mechanisms. Whole-surah recurrences repeatedly paired expansion with its controls: dispatch and reception, force and sorting, enclosure and emergence, gathering and articulation, speech and silence, destructive sparks and nourishing flow.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine plural agents remain unspecified, so shared morphology does not prove that 77:1-5 names one agent class.
The documentary and speech models may be functional analogies rather than the direct lexical target of ن ش ر in the focus.
The resurrection, embryological, and ecological cycles coexist but need not collapse into one referent.
Fragrance, sawing, and generosity are branch-grounded outliers whose contextual fit is too distant for unqualified prose.
